messages:
Anya Blake: flagging a gap we saw in onboarding callbacks: some third-party webhooks return 202s with delayed processing and we end up creating duplicate followups in CRM. want to pilot a lightweight validation layer before playbook routing.

Marcus Li: ugh yep saw that last week. whats the minimal validation? event_id dedupe + status probe?

Deepa Rao: propose: 1) require event_id and source_ts, 2) validate payload hash against a short cache (ttl 5m) to catch retries, 3) optional callback probe to confirm enrichment success before setting owner nudges.

Anya Blake: love it. keep it opt-in via playbook meta so we can enable per-integration. also add per-owner debounce so owners don't get surge of replays.

Marcus Li: sample playbook fragment (staging):
```
id: onboarding.callback-validation-v1
trigger: onboarding.callback_received
conditions: []
actions:
  - validate_fields: [event_id, source_ts]
  - check_duplicate: cache_ttl_seconds=300, dedupe_key=event_id
  - optional_probe: url=integration_status_endpoint, timeout=2s
  - set_crm_field: callback_validated=true
  - route_to_owner: owner_field=owner_id
meta:
  feature_flag: callback_validation_v1
  integration_whitelist: [partner_a, partner_b]
```

Deepa Rao: ops notes: if probe fails, set crm.callback_issue=true and emit metric `onboarding.callback.probe.fail`. keep retries limited to 2 and exponential backoff, then dead-letter to manual queue.

Playbook Bot: playbook-runner: draft created in staging (callback-validation-v1).

Julio Ramos: acceptance criteria: duplicate rate drops by >= 90% in canary segment, owner queue delta < 20, probe failure < 1% for whitelisted partners. I'll run replay tests tomorrow.

Anya Blake: rollout: stage -> whitelisted partners in prod 1% -> monitor 48h -> expand. quick sync in #cs-ops 09:30 PT tomorrow. thanks everyone.
